pick.thesis: Fast mover: day-1 hold after best-in-class DM1 splicing data; ~$415M cap vs multi-billion DM1 peers, crowded and already +130%.
pick.catalyst: Positive Phase 2 FREEDOM2-DM1 10 mg/kg data (Nov 10): 46.5% mean splicing correction vs 6.8% placebo, functional gains, no SAEs
pick.notes: Gap rule: cap >$300M and holding above open after 60 min; dilution check: no S-3/424B in 90 days but shelf declared effective May 2026.

reasons.text: Primary 8-K: highest splicing correction reported in a multiple-dose DM1 study, 5 of 6 patients >20%
Funded into 2028 ($104.8M cash) and holding above its $5.55 open an hour into the session
Risk: already +130%, X mentions ~18x normal (crowded/late), and an effective shelf makes a follow-on offering likely

pick.bullCase: analyst upgrades and partner/buyout interest re-rate it toward DM1 peers (Novartis paid ~$12B for Avidity in 2025)
